question: According to Proverbs 8:35-36, what is the difference between finding Wisdom and hating her?
options: Finding her brings riches; hating her brings sadness
Finding her brings life; hating her means loving death
Finding her brings fame; hating her brings shame
explanation: Proverbs 8:35-36 says whoever finds Wisdom finds life and receives favor from the LORD, but all who hate her love death.
